WhatsaapAccount.notes: time the system automatically retrieves new session cookies

whiteListMode.notes: if you enable this feature, only the ids in the whiteListIds list can use the bot (Inbox/DMs)

whiteListGroup.notes: if you enable this feature, only the thread in the whiteListThreadIds list can use the bot

whiteListChannel.notes: DISABLED — bot will not respond in channels/communities.

DATABASE.notes: type selects 'sqlite' or 'mongodb'. If you choose mongodb, enter your mongodb uri string.

autoRestart.notes: you can set time is interval with milisecond or cron time, example: 1000, 10000, 60000, 3600000, 86400000, 0 0 * * *,... If you set time is 0 or false or null, the bot will not auto restart

autoUptime.notes: the value of timeInterval is seconds
